subject: plot mean of points at a single location

messages.author: 55862ed2ee4180f3
messages.subject: plot mean of points at a single location
parts:
Hi,

I believe this to be an easy question, but I am stumped.

I have multiple measurements at set of locations. Without preprocessing it using plyr or aggregate, how would I set color or size to reflect the mean?

For example,

temp <- data.frame( x = rep(1:3, each = 3), y = rep(1:3, each = 3), value = rnorm(9))

p <- ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y), data = temp)

## for each point, I would like to have the color or size represent the mean - or some other statistic.

p + geom_point(aes(col = mean) )



Thanks,

Matt

messages.author: 5a37f1244321fb07
messages.subject: RE: plot mean of points at a single location
parts:
I guess you may want to do something like this? (I changed y=y to y=value)

ggplot(aes(x = x, y = value), data = temp) +
geom_point() +
stat_summary(fun.y=mean, geom="point", shape=18, size=5, col="red")

Kaori

messages.subject: Re: plot mean of points at a single location
parts:
This works too, and is less confusing notationally:

p+geom_point(aes(color=value,stat="summary",fun="mean"))

Re your question, I think just

p+geom_point(aes(size=value,stat="summary",fun="max"))

Ben
